'''Ōi Shrine''' (大井神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}} with the name "Ōi" located in various places across Japan.

== Ōi Shrines List ==
* {{ill|Ōi Shrine (Mito)|ja|大井神社 (水戸市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōi Shrine (Mito)|qq=}}（{{ill|Ibaraki Prefecture|en|Ibaraki Prefecture|qid=Q83273|lt=Ibaraki|1=Ibaraki Prefecture}} [[Mito, Ibaraki|Mito City]]） - A Shikinaisha (式内社) candidate shrine. The enshrined deity Kashima-no-Mikoto (建借馬命) had the former name Ōfu-no-Omi (意富臣), which later became "Ōi" through phonetic changes.
* {{ill|Ōi Shrine (Kasama)|ja|大井神社 (笠間市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōi Shrine (Kasama)|qq=}}（Ibaraki Prefecture {{ill|Kasama, Ibaraki|en|Kasama, Ibaraki|qid=Q845851|lt=Kasama City|1=Kasama, Ibaraki}}） - Shikinaisha candidate shrine.
* {{ill|Oi Shrine|ja|大井神社 (島田市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Oi Shrine|qq=}}（{{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|en|Shizuoka Prefecture|qid=Q131320|lt=Shizuoka|1=Shizuoka Prefecture}} {{ill|Shimada, Shizuoka|en|Shimada, Shizuoka|qid=Q605256|lt=Shimada City|1=Shimada, Shizuoka}}） - Kokushi Genzaisha (国史見在社) and Beppyo Shrine (別表神社). Famous for the [[Shimada Obi Festival|Shimada no Obi Matsuri]]. There are several other shrines with the same name along the [[Ōi River (Shizuoka)|Ōi River]] basin.
* {{ill|Ōi Shrine (Nagoya)|ja|大井神社 (名古屋市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōi Shrine (Nagoya)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}（{{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi|1=Aichi Prefecture}} {{ill|Nagoya|en|Nagoya|qid=Q11751|lt=Nagoya City|1=Nagoya}}）
* {{ill|Ōi Shrine (Aisai)|ja|大井神社 (愛西市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōi Shrine (Aisai)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}（Aichi Prefecture [[:en:Aisai, Aichi|Aisai City]]）
* {{ill|Ōi Shrine (Kitagata)|ja|大井神社 (北方町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōi Shrine (Kitagata)|1=Oi Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11432215}}（{{ill|Gifu Prefecture|en|Gifu Prefecture|qid=Q131277|lt=Gifu|1=Gifu Prefecture}} {{ill|Kitagata, Gifu|en|Kitagata, Gifu|qid=Q1203696|lt=Kitagata Town|1=Kitagata, Gifu}} {{ill|Motosu District, Gifu|en|Motosu District, Gifu|qid=Q1204331|lt=Motosu District|1=Motosu District, Gifu}}）
* {{ill|Ōi Shrine (Kyoto)|ja|大井神社 (京都市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōi Shrine (Kyoto)|1=Oi Shrine (Kyoto)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11432214}}（{{ill|Kyoto Prefecture|en|Kyoto Prefecture|qid=Q120730|lt=Kyoto|1=Kyoto Prefecture}} {{ill|Kyoto|en|Kyoto|qid=Q34600|lt=Kyoto City|1=Kyoto}} {{ill|Ukyō-ku, Kyoto|en|Ukyō-ku, Kyoto|qid=Q580186|lt=Ukyō Ward|1=Ukyō-ku, Kyoto}}） - Shikinaisha candidate shrine. Named after the [[Ōigawa (Kyoto)|Ōi River (Kyoto)]].
* {{ill|Ōi Shrine (Kameoka)|ja|大井神社 (亀岡市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōi Shrine (Kameoka)|1=Ooi Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11432213}}（Kyoto Prefecture {{ill|Kameoka, Kyoto|en|Kameoka, Kyoto|qid=Q633996|lt=Kameoka City|1=Kameoka, Kyoto}}） - Shikinaisha.
